title: Add entropy-weighted prompt sampler and CI adapter for variable-sensitivity prompts
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: some prompt-sets contain questions or prefixes that are inherently more sensitive to small model changes (high token-entropy or multiple valid continuations). We need a sampling and CI adapter that prioritizes those prompts for regression checks without inflating CI cost. This PR implements an entropy-weighted prompt sampler (offline tool + in-PR CI adapter) that: 1) computes per-prompt entropy signatures from recent model runs, 2) uses an adjustable weighting function to upsample high-entropy prompts in nightly and pre-merge smoke suites, and 3) exposes a CI adapter that converts per-prompt deltas into entropy-aware failure scores and dynamic thresholds. The adapter reduces false positives on low-entropy prompts while ensuring high-sensitivity prompts block regressions.

What this change includes: entropy-based sampler binary (python), a lightweight CI adapter hook that integrates with the existing eval-harness reporter, new unit and integration tests, and a migration script to produce initial entropy signatures from last 30d runs. The CI adapter is opt-in via eval-config: "enable_entropy_adapter: true" and has tunables: base_threshold, entropy_alpha, min_samples. Backwards compatibility: default is disabled; adapters are additive and do not change existing thresholds unless enabled.
commits: 1) Add entropy sampler module and CLI to tools/entropy_sampler.py; 2) Add CI adapter glue and scoring function in eval_harness/adapters/entropy_adapter.py; 3) Add unit tests for sampler and adapter; 4) Add docs and config examples; 5) Add migration script to tools/compute_initial_entropy_signatures.py
diff_snippets:
eval_harness/adapters/entropy_adapter.py: added core scoring function
+def entropy_weighted_score(delta, entropy, alpha):
+    return delta * (1 + alpha * entropy)

tools/entropy_sampler.py: new CLI that computes per-prompt entropy by replaying recent model outputs and aggregating token-level surprisals.
docs/ci_adapters/entropy_adapter.md: doc that explains tuning knobs and opt-in config.
testing_and_ci_notes: Unit tests added for sampler deterministic behaviour and adapter scoring. Integration test runs the adapter against a small snapshot (100 prompts) and asserts the adapter reweights high-entropy prompts into the top-20 sample. CI: full test matrix passed; a nightly smoke job flaked once due to transient GPU quota; rerun succeeded. Test coverage +3% for eval-harness package.
review_comments:
Liam Chen: 'This looks sensible and the math is straightforward. Please add a short explanation (1-2 lines) in the docs about why we use multiplicative weighting (delta*(1+alpha*entropy)) vs additive.'

Asha (author): 'Added a paragraph in docs/ci_adapters/entropy_adapter.md explaining multiplicative choice — preserves relative delta ordering while amplifying high-entropy signals; added a quick unit test for behavior consistency.'

Priya Kapoor: 'Can we guard against small-sample noise? The adapter should not overreact when entropy is high but sample_count < min_samples.'

Asha: 'Added min_samples check to the adapter and included backoff logic (fallback to base_threshold). Updated integration tests.'

Marco Ruiz: 'Consider adding a telemetry counter for prompts that crossed the entropy threshold and caused CI blocks.'

Asha: 'Added telemetry events: eval.entropy_adapter.alerts and eval.entropy_adapter.samples_upsampled. These are noop if telemetry is disabled.'

Approvals: Liam Chen (approved), Priya Kapoor (approved after change), Marco Ruiz (approved)
ci_checks: build: pass; lint: pass; unit-tests: pass; integration-tests: pass (one rerun); nightly-smoke: pass after rerun; security-scan: pass
release_notes: Add entropy-weighted prompt sampling and CI adapter (opt-in). Improves detection of regressions on high-variability prompts while reducing noise from stable prompts. See docs/ci_adapters/entropy_adapter.md for configuration and tuning guidance.
rollout_plan: Stage 1: land as opt-in (this PR) and enable for two internal services' nightly suites. Stage 2: monitor telemetry (alerts, false-positive rate) for 2 weeks. Stage 3: recommend enabling on per-team basis and add to default nightly matrix if stable. Backout: disable flag in eval-config or remove adapter from CI matrix.
notes_for_operators: Entropy signatures are stored as compressed JSON in S3 path s3://redwood-evals/entropy_signatures/YYYYMMDD.json; migration script produces initial file. Adapter tolerates missing signatures (falls back to base thresholds). Tune entropy_alpha in range [0.1, 2.0] depending on desired sensitivity.
human_readable_summary: Implements an entropy-aware sampling strategy and CI adapter to prioritize prompt-sets that are more likely to expose model regressions. Opt-in, tested, and merged after review. Includes docs and telemetry hooks.
